about: AnimForge clip taxonomy (plan docs/plans/artbible-enemy-animations.md, phase A0). 'clips' = what AnimForge authors; 'enemies' = every clip each art-bible JSON (docs/art/data/*.json, enemies[].rig.animations) asks for, mapped to a source clip or dropped with a reason. Event t is normalized (0..1) clip time. Check coverage with python3 Tools/ArtForge/anim_spec_check.py.
root_motion: none: every clip is in place; the NavMeshAgent moves the guard (decision 'Motion')

event_types.Footstep: a foot plants; drives FootstepNoiseEmitter (param foot L/R)
event_types.PropDetach: a prop leaves the rig (param prop = bone name): lantern, helm, shield, match

layers.base: shared humanoid motion on the reference skeleton (Humanoid_Base.fbx)
layers.carry: a base clip with the enemy's carry pose on the upper-body mask (arms, shoulders, prop bones)
layers.family: one weapon-family clip shared by every enemy with that weapon, on the reference skeleton
layers.signature: a motion only one enemy has, in that enemy's own FBX (moves its prop bones)

playback: An enemy clip plays its source at playback_rate. Locomotion: rate = agent speed / authored speed, which keeps the feet planted; the Animator speed parameter should drive it.

idle.notes: weight shift L->R->L, breathing, head glance

walk_slow.notes: the JSON patrol pace (walk_round 1.1 m/s); heavies' 0.9-1.5 m/s blends between walk_slow and walk

walk.notes: engine patrol agent speed (role table: patrol 2.0 m/s)

run.notes: engine chase agent speed (role table: patrol chase 4.2 m/s)

alert_turn.notes: head leads, chest follows, hips last; authored turning LEFT, mirror for right. The agent does the actual yaw over the same 0.6 s

shout.notes: cups the left hand to the mouth, chest out, bellows. The noise is gameplay (driver), not a clip event

stagger.notes: full-body recoil, two catch steps back

knock_down.notes: non-lethal fall onto the back (stun, knock-down); killed/thrown guards use the ragdoll

get_up.notes: from knock_down's last pose to standing

archway_duck.notes: dips head and shoulders ~0.12 m; additive over walk

sleep.notes: Somnus: dozes on his feet, knees soft, chin on chest, slow breathing

levitate_struggle.notes: Levo: held off the ground, legs kick, arms flail

alert_turn_body.notes: whole-body turn for helmed heavies who cannot turn the head

shrug.notes: small additive rock for hits that do not stagger

crouch_cover.notes: crouched to 1.25 m behind cover, peeks

kneel.notes: drops to one knee (heavy stagger, stagger_back)

polearm_guard.notes: two-handed ready stance, haft levelled at the hip, point at chest height; the family's rest pose

polearm_thrust.notes: draw back (anticipation) 0-0.38, lunge-thrust peak 0.5, overshoot, recover

polearm_sweep.notes: wind-up to the right, wide horizontal cut at knee height across to the left

polearm_cant.notes: additive: tilts the pole 35 deg forward from the carry (doors, vault ribs, archways)

polearm_cant_back.notes: additive: tilts a sloped pole back so its tip drops (halberd under arches)

polearm_thrust_overhand.notes: overhand spear jab over a shield

shield_guard.notes: shield forward, weapon over the rim (loop)

sword_overhead.notes: heavy downward cut, 0.4 s wind-up tell

shield_bash.notes: steps in and shoves with the shield
